question: Budhaditya Mukherjee is associated with which of the following musical instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sitar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Budhaditya Mukherjee:-**

 
 
• Pandit Budhadityaji was born in 1955 in Durg, Chattisgarh.
 
• He is considered as the leading sitarist of his generation. (Hence option 4 is correct)
 
• Budhadityaji received his entire training in Sitar from his father, Pandit Bimalendu Mukherjee.
 
• He has, since 1979, performed in 26 countries including the UK., USA., Canada, Australia, New Zealand, the UAE, Armenia, and in almost all European countries.
 
• On June 30, 1990, Budhaditya Mukherjee created history by becoming the first-ever musician to perform at the House of Commons, London.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Veena:- 

 
 
• The veena is a plucked string instrument that is popular in Indian music.
 
• It has a long and rich history, dating back to ancient times.
 
• The veena is mentioned in the Rigveda, one of the oldest Hindu scriptures.
 
 
 
• **Violin:-**
 
 
• The violin is a stringed instrument that is played with a bow.
 
• It is one of the most popular instruments in the world, and it is used in a wide variety of musical genres, including classical, folk, jazz, and rock.
 
 
 
• **Sarangi**:-
 
 
• The sarangi is a bowed string instrument that is popular in Indian music.
 
• It has a long and rich history, dating back to at least the 13th century.
 
• The sarangi is known for its expressive and soulful sound, and it is often used to accompany vocalists or to play solo.
